'''''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series of one-shot issues by [[Marvel Comics]] that celebrate the 40th anniversary of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. The [[Return of the Jedi – Jabba's Palace 1|first issue]] of the series was written by [[Marc Guggenheim]], illustrated by [[Alessandro Miracolo]], and published on [[March 29]], [[2023]].

One issue, [[Return of the Jedi – Smugglers 1|''Return of the Jedi – Smugglers'' 1]], was teased but never released.<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=STAR-WARS-SCOUNDRELS-REBELS-EMPIRE/dp/1302953370|text=STAR WARS: SCOUNDRELS, REBELS AND THE EMPIRE|nolive=1}}</ref>
